description: Changes the design settings of a project’s model: roof shape, facade material, window frames, building style, roof covering, number and height of storeys, north direction. Only the values given change. The model and every later image use them. vedutum_undo_last_change goes back. Costs no points.

facade.description: render (white), renderGrey, larch (light timber), larchDark, brick, brickLight, concrete, metal

frame.description: Window frames: anthracite, white, oak, bronze, black

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

north_angle.description: Turn of the plan against north in degrees

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

roof_cover.description: standard (fits the style), tileRed, tileAnthracite, slate, metal, green; no effect on a flat roof except green

storeys.description: Storeys above ground; storeys without their own plan repeat the ground floor

style.description: modern, klassisch, gruenderzeit, laendlich, alpin, mediterran, skandinavisch, bauhaus

name: vedutum_set_design
title: Set roof, facade and style of the model
